review_candidates.title: Patient Care Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Summary The Patient Care Specialist is responsible for managing patient inquiries, qualifying leads, and providing accurate information about healthcare and laboratory services, including testing options and billing. The role acts as a key link between patients, clinical teams, and marketing to ensure a smooth patient experience, generate qualified leads, and support service conversion. Key Responsibilities Handle patient inquiries through WhatsApp and other communication channels in a timely and professional manner. Understand patient needs, qualify leads, and provide accurate information about relevant services, testing options, requirements, and billing. Follow up with qualified and interested leads to support conversion into confirmed bookings. Address patient questions and concerns and escalate clinical inquiries to the appropriate team when needed. Coordinate with clinical, laboratory, and marketing teams to ensure patients receive accurate and consistent information. Maintain accurate CRM records and track leads, follow-ups, bookings, and outcomes. Support customer satisfaction and contribute to agreed customer service and lead-generation targets. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Science, Biotechnology, or a related healthcare field. 3–5 years of relevant experience in healthcare, patient care, medical customer service, or a similar role. Previous experience in the healthcare industry is required. A very good command of English, written and spoken, is a MUST. Proven experience in handling customer/patient inquiries and qualifying leads. Strong ability to communicate healthcare services and billing information clearly and accurately. Excellent communication, interpersonal, follow-up, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively with patients, clinical teams, and marketing teams. Experience in healthcare sales, medical sales, patient acquisition, or lead conversion is a MUST. Results-oriented, proactive, and patient-focused.

review_candidates.description: * CONTINGENT UPON AWARD * This is not a traditional administrative Executive Assistant role. The ideal candidate can anticipate needs, make sound decisions within established parameters, and ensure that priorities move from direction to execution. This role in on-site in Washington, D.C. There are not remote opportunities. Executive Support & Coordination Provide comprehensive administrative support to senior leaders, including calendar management, meeting coordination, and correspondence. Manage complex scheduling requirements, including classified and unclassified meetings, secure facility access, and leadership engagements. Prepare, review, and format executive documents, briefings, talking points, and presentation materials. Handle sensitive information with discretion, professionalism, and strict adherence to security protocols. Planning, Meetings & Event Logistics Organize and support leadership meetings, strategy sessions, offsites, and cross‑functional team workshops. Coordinate logistics for meetings in SCIF/SAPF environments, including technology setup, visitor management, and security procedures. Track and distribute meeting agendas, materials, and read‑aheads; capture and follow up on action items. Support planning and execution of all‑hands events, town halls, listening sessions, and stakeholder engagements. Operational & Administrative Management Maintain executive files, templates, trackers, dashboards, and repository systems (SharePoint, Teams, etc.). Monitor deadlines and ensure leadership is prepared for key reviews, decision forums, and program milestones. Assist in developing and maintaining operating rhythms, workflows, and internal communication processes. Support travel coordination, expense reports, procurement requests, and other administrative processes in accordance with government and contractor requirements. Team Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination Serve as a central point of coordination across OCM, training, communications, strategy, and technology modernization workstreams. Partner with team leads to streamline processes, track deliverables, and support integrated planning. Assist in onboarding new team members, ensuring they have access, equipment, and required clearances. Maintain strong working relationships with government stakeholders, contractor partners, and cross-functional teams. Communication & Documentation Draft and coordinate internal communications, announcements, and updates on behalf of leadership. Ensure consistent formatting and quality control across documents and presentations produced by the team. Maintain logs, summaries, and documentation needed to support leadership visibility and informed decision-making. Required Qualifications Active Secret Clearance 8-10 years of experience providing administrative or executive support in fast‑paced, highly structured, or government environments. Experience working with senior executives or flag‑level leadership (military or civilian). Strong organizational, multitasking, and prioritization skills with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to prepare polished and professional documents. High level of discretion and ability to manage sensitive information in classified environments. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, SharePoint, and collaboration tools. IAAP CAP certification or similar, preferred. The anticipated salary range for this role is $115,000 to $135,000 annually. The anticipated salary range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. The final starting salary will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, skills, relevant experience, education, certifications, and work location (where applicable), as well as internal equity and market considerations. review_candidates.title: Bank Accountant
review_candidates.description: Company Description Mas Financial is a growing financial services organization focused on providing reliable banking and credit solutions to individuals and businesses. The company emphasizes strong financial controls, transparent operations, and customer-centric service. Team members work in a structured yet collaborative environment with opportunities to contribute to process improvement and operational efficiency. Mas Financial supports professional development, encouraging continuous learning in accounting, banking operations, and financial technologies. The organization values integrity, accuracy, and compliance with regulatory standards in all activities. Role Description The Bank Accountant at Mas Financial is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo. The role involves daily recording, reconciliation, and monitoring of financial transactions, including deposits, loans, payments, and bank fees. The Bank Accountant prepares journal entries, maintains general ledgers, performs account reconciliations, and supports month-end and year-end closing activities. Responsibilities include reviewing financial data for accuracy, assisting in financial reporting, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements, and supporting internal and external audits. The role also involves coordinating with operations and customer service teams to resolve discrepancies, improve accounting processes, and provide timely, accurate financial information to management. Qualifications Strong knowledge of accounting principles, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and financial reporting. Proficiency in accounting software, spreadsheets (e.g., Microsoft Excel), and basic financial analysis tools. Attention to detail, high level of accuracy, and ability to identify and resolve discrepancies in financial data. Understanding of banking operations, regulatory requirements, and internal control practices. Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams on-site in Cairo. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA) are an advantage. Experience in banking or financial services accounting is preferred; entry-level candidates with strong fundamentals may also be considered. Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to evolving processes and systems.
